issue.title: Finish the Mac wake notice acceptance on an isolated harness
issue.description: Close bob-cli-q5.8.1.6.5 by running the six end-to-end wake-notice checks on the real Mac against a scratch app that has its own bundle ID, defaults domain, hotkey, state, and vault, so production Bob Mac Capture is never disturbed again, and by recording durable per-check evidence.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/mac_wake_notice_acceptance.md requests this work

issue.title: Build the isolated acceptance harness and settle the CI precondition
issue.description: harness: settle master exact-SHA CI for ba213181, then build a scratch Bob Mac Capture with its own bundle ID, defaults domain, disabled hotkeys, XDG state, disposable vault, signpost evidence log, production guard, and teardown, prove one wake end to end through signposts, and get its notification permission granted.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/mac_wake_notice_acceptance.md defines phase harness as one work unit

issue.title: Accept delivery, lock and unlock, and channel routing
issue.description: delivery: on the harness, run checks 1, 2, and 6 of plan:202611/mac_snooze_wake_notice.md: one active wake gives one HUD, chime, and record with no second nudge from pings, repeats, or restart; a genuine locked wake stays silent and appears after unlock; and auto, desktop, off, and old-bob routing behave.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/mac_wake_notice_acceptance.md defines phase delivery as one work unit

issue.title: Accept meeting holds and HUD actions
issue.description: meetings-actions: on the harness, run checks 3 and 4: running and overlapping meetings hold until their real end and filter tasks changed during the hold; Open and batch +15m work, partial and refused writes stay truthful, hover pauses the countdown, and focus stays in the original app.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/mac_wake_notice_acceptance.md defines phase meetings-actions as one work unit

issue.title: Accept beacon, records, accessibility, and expiry
issue.description: records-a11y: on the harness, run check 5: beacon and record clearing, notification denial, Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency, the VoiceOver announcement, day rollover, and the 60-minute expiry, then tear the harness down.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/mac_wake_notice_acceptance.md defines phase records-a11y as one work unit
